decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - 3	Detailed drawings showing the following modifications:
a)	suitable division/nibs between the front and rear rooms (1st Floor) studio one
b)	suitable division/nibs between the front and rear rooms (1st Floor) studio two
c)	omission of window detail (ground floor) wG8
shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Authority before the commence of the relevant works.

Condition : 4 - 4	Full details of the proposed partitions dividing studios 1 and 2 shall be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Authority before the commence of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 5 - 5	Samples of all new work to match and method statements for repair work to existing internal features listed below:
a)	plasterwork
b)	cornices
c)	architrave
d)	skirting, 
e)	doors
f)	shutters
g)	brackets
h)	decorative bolections, dado or panelling (to include positioning and location)
i)	flooring 
shall be submitted and agreed on site and in writing by the Local Authority before the commence of the relevant work.

Condition : 6 - The position, type and manner of installation of all new and relocated services and related fittings shall be specified in writing in advance of any work being carried out, and the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority must be obtained wherever these installations are to be visible or where ducts or other methods of concealment are proposed.

Condition : 8 - The primary use of the ground and first floor of the premises shall be Class B1 (Office Use) and for no other purpose, including any other purpose in Class B of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification.
description: Change of use at ground and first floor level from A3 to B1 (offices) and residential at second floor
